title: lp-ip.model/1 LP/MIP model artifact
description: minimize or maximize objective_offset + objective . x subject to row_lower <= A x <= row_upper and variable_lower <= x <= variable_upper, x[j] integral where kinds[j] is integer or binary.
$comment: Rules outside this schema, checked by the worker: n = len(objective) >= 1 and m = len(row_lower); variable_lower, variable_upper and kinds have n entries and row_upper has m; lower <= upper for every variable and row, where null means -infinity as a lower and +infinity as an upper bound (JSON has no NaN or Infinity); a binary variable needs bounds inside [0, 1]. Solver domain, reported per task as termination unsupported instead of a validation error: a MIP needs finite bounds of magnitude at most 2^53-1 on every variable, continuous ones included, after root bound inference, which runs only with presolve true. Integers are written without a fraction or exponent. scripts/mps_to_model.py converts MPS files to this format.

matrix.description: A in zero-based compressed sparse row (CSR) form, row-major over the m rows.
matrix.$comment: len(indptr) = m + 1, indptr[0] = 0, indptr never decreases and indptr[m] = len(indices) = len(values). Row r holds the entries indptr[r] up to indptr[r+1] - 1; their indices are strictly increasing (sorted, no duplicates) and below n. Explicit zeros are allowed. A model without rows uses indptr [0].
